sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production material texture for a hand-painted 2D Chinese countryside farming game. A completely flat orthographic TOP-DOWN seamless tile of aged honey oak floorboards, warm muted medium brown, very subtle grain and a few tiny knots, staggered end joints. Twelve narrow horizontal parallel wooden boards across the square texture, with hairline dark seams, each board restrained tonal variation. Soft painterly gouache detail, visual texture suitable beneath small character sprites, readable planks at a distance, no photoreal gloss. Even diffuse illumination over entire image, NO perspective, NO room, NO objects, NO borders, NO frames, NO labels, NO text, NO cast shadows. All four edges should tile seamlessly. 1024 x 1024 square bitmap, full opaque surface.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production terrain trim texture for a hand-painted 2D Chinese countryside farming game. An orthographic overhead very long HORIZONTAL riverbank ribbon, across the full width. Top side: irregular soft sparse moss/short muted sage grass lip. Middle: warm beige sand and fine pale gray pebbles, weathered earthen edge. Bottom side: a thin damp darker brown sandy margin tapering softly to genuine transparency. Overall ribbon occupies middle half of a wide 1536 x 512 canvas, transparent clear area above and below. Detailed tiny pebbles and subtle scattered grass blades, NOT large rocks, NOT reeds, NO flowers, NO separate piles. Painted gouache finish, earthy quiet colors, even diffuse light. The main shoreline line is gently irregular but globally straight horizontal so it can be curved by a game mesh. The left and right ends continue across canvas edges and match seamlessly. Entire upper and lower edges fade softly to genuine transparency, no opaque rectangular backing. NO water, no sky, no scene, no perspective, no shadows outside trim, no labels, no grid, no text.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D decorative interior PROP ATLAS for a hand-painted cozy Chinese countryside game, four separately isolated props on a genuinely transparent background, 2 equal columns x 2 equal rows, clear safety gaps between quadrants. Elevated orthographic 3/4 game view with FRONT VISIBLE, matching painted gouache aged wood, cream plaster interiors, honey oak and muted sage cloth. Upper-left cell: SMALL WALL-MOUNTED OIL LANTERN with short wooden wall bracket, bronze metal cage and warm amber glass, rustic early 20th century rural home; lamp is the whole object, no wall patch, NO long standing pole, no huge glow halo. Upper-right cell: ONE narrow simple wooden FLOATING WALL SHELF with two cream/brown ceramic tea jars and three modest cups, clean readable silhouette, no cupboard, no wall background. Lower-left cell: hanging bundle of dried sage medicinal herbs tied with natural string and tiny wooden hook, no wall. Lower-right cell: tiny tea service with one dark earthenware teapot and two small cream cups on a flat bamboo tray, seen from elevated 3/4 game perspective, no table under it. ALL props evenly centered in their own equal cells with generous transparent padding, no shadows outside object silhouettes, soft top-left diffuse lighting. These are four individual transparent props, NOT a room, NOT a collage on a backdrop, NO labels, no captions, NO text, no grid lines. Highest attention to handmade material detail while staying readable at small sprite size. Square atlas.

Use case: stylized-concept. A production MATERIAL TEXTURE ATLAS for a softly hand-painted 2D Chinese rural-life game. ONE opaque very wide 3:1 image, exactly THREE equal SQUARE cells side by side, covering the full canvas, no padding or separator lines. Each cell is a flat orthographic TOP-DOWN repeating floor material under identical neutral even illumination. LEFT CELL: weathered cool blue-gray clay floor bricks, eight staggered rows of narrow rectangular bricks, thin restrained dark grout lines, subtle hand-painted mineral and worn variations, no broken rubble. MIDDLE CELL: natural muted straw-olive BAMBOO WOVEN FLOOR MAT, broad restrained weave with tiny alternating fibers, soft quiet contrast, no border, no ornaments, no leaf shapes, no wooden planks. RIGHT CELL: smooth old-fashioned light warm-gray TERRAZZO floor with a fine DENSE UNIFORM distribution of tiny subtle gray and beige mineral flecks; fine material grain, low contrast, NO large chips, NO circular areas or patches, NO visible large grid, NO stains. Gouache/painterly material detail, not photoreal gloss. The three textures occupy precise equal thirds and their contents reach the full outer edges; each square is independently seamless at its edges. NO perspective, no bevels, no vignette, no directional light gradient, NO objects, NO text, NO labels, no frame. Intended output 1536 x 512 pixels, three square material swatches.
